yontem.ne: Open-source AI agent harness for team collaboration with shared context via browser-based access.
Local AI agent setup to reduce cloud costs and enable team-wide access to preloaded contexts.

akis.ne: TrueForge'ın tanıtımı ve kullanımını açıklayan video içeriği sunuldu.
akis.alinti: Somebody finally built the exact harness that Sam Altman asked for. It's called TrueForge, and it's an open-source AI agent harness by TrueFoundry. Now, the problem is that the AI that you use every day lives on your phone and your computer. Your setup, your context, and nobody else on your team can touch any of it. But with TrueForge, you set it up once, and the entire team opens up the same agent in their browser. With all the context that you preloaded, here's how you can use it. Just type in this command and paste in your API key from any provider. Comment True down below, and I'll send you the link to get started. And then make sure to go and give that repo a huge star.
